name: JEDEC Standard
description: JEDEC 표준(JESD 시리즈) 전용. 1단 레이아웃, 표 캡션은 위·그림 캡션은 아래, 굵은 번호 제목, JESD 문서번호/리비전 추출, 타이밍·상태 다이어그램 해석 규칙.

image_types.prompt: This is a JEDEC timing diagram. List every signal row from top to bottom (e.g. CK_t, CK_c, CA, CMD, DQS_t, DQS_c, DQ). Then describe the order of events along the time axis using the T0, T1... markers when present (commands such as ACT, RD, WR, PRE, DES; strobe preamble/postamble; data beats D0..Dn). Then list every timing parameter or latency annotation (tRCD, RL, WL, tDQSCK...) with value and unit exactly as printed. Do not compute or infer values that are not printed.
